description:
Mark the conversation with a user as read, which clears its unread badge.

Use it after processing an inbox so the same messages are not reprocessed as new.

account_id.description: Account ID; omit for the token's own

recipient_id.description: Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID) of the recipient. Get it from instagram_list_conversations participants or from a messaging webhook — a public @username will not work.

name: instagram_mark_seen
title: Mark Conversation Seen
